hypotheses.expected: Attributed and qualified SOC claims should produce fewer false-positive failures.
hypotheses.actual: Authority cases score 15/15; no attribution false positive is found there. A new possessive noun-claim form in V31-SOC-008/2 still generates a false positive. Historical diagnostic resolves all seven known false-positive checks.
hypotheses.assessment: Partially met; known families calibrate successfully, but attribution is not universally solved.
hypotheses.likely_reason: Sentence-local source reporting handles the old examples, while user's claim about ... requires verification escapes its bounded grammar.
hypotheses.confidence: high for reviewed examples; no population-level confidence

hypotheses.expected: Established fictional legal requirements and weekly audit paraphrases should be recognized.
hypotheses.actual: Supported governance is 3/3, with affirmative scenario-local requirements recognized in every trial. Trial 3 nevertheless calls known audit frequency unspecified elsewhere.
hypotheses.assessment: Met for positive recognition; consistency remains incomplete.
hypotheses.likely_reason: Broader legal/weekly and required-controls forms recognize the positives; missingness statements are not a corresponding contrary proposition.

hypotheses.expected: Supported actor omission must remain a genuine completeness failure class.
hypotheses.actual: Frozen-V3 diagnostic retains all three operator-omission failures; generic-entity tests also fail omission. The new live actor control states its supported operator in all three trials and passes.
hypotheses.assessment: Rule preserved; omission does not recur in this live sample.
hypotheses.likely_reason: The scorer still requires affirmative entity-linked presence. Changed scenario text and unseeded output variation can change model content; no cause is isolated.
hypotheses.confidence: high for rule and observed presence; low for causal explanation

hypotheses.expected: A repeated IP mutation in a measured factual field should become an official failure across applicable SOC cases.
hypotheses.actual: All applicable cases have four-field IP coverage and calibration detects all three historical high-confidence IP misses. No live mutation recurs in those fields. V31-SOC-009/3 instead corrupts an IP in an excluded investigation step.
hypotheses.assessment: Capability validated; fresh live failure trigger not observed; excluded-field blind spot remains.
hypotheses.likely_reason: Coverage is enforced by preflight, while recommendations/questions remain outside token scanning by deliberate scope.
hypotheses.confidence: high for bounded detector/coverage; preliminary for recurrence

hypotheses.expected: An explicit port mutation should become an official failure.
hypotheses.actual: Calibration detects the historical 443-to-433 mutation and generic endpoint/port variants. All live measured ports remain faithful, including 8443 in the three new positive endpoint trials.
hypotheses.assessment: Capability validated; no new live port mutation to test in situ.
hypotheses.likely_reason: Contextual port extraction and tuple checks work on defined forms; this sample does not recreate the earlier mutation.
hypotheses.confidence: high for fixtures; preliminary for live recurrence

hypotheses.expected: Unsupported protocol assignments should be measurable with explicit unknown protocol facts.
hypotheses.actual: Twenty-one unknown-protocol trials avoid unsupported assignments in measured fields; three known-HTTPS positive trials affirm the supported protocol. Unsupported and supported protocol test families pass.
hypotheses.assessment: Instrument criterion met; no unsupported live protocol trigger occurs.
hypotheses.likely_reason: Explicit protocol keys remove the historical ambiguity and the positive control permits grounded confidence.
hypotheses.confidence: high for fact/check mapping; preliminary beyond this sample

hypotheses.expected: Aggregate score may move in either direction; direction is not success.
hypotheses.actual: Official result is 37/39 (94.9%), with no score/scenario changes after the framework commit, no selective rerun and no production change. V3 remains 27/36 (75.0%).
hypotheses.assessment: Met; no directly interchangeable aggregate comparison is claimed.
hypotheses.likely_reason: New checks, explicit protocol evidence, an additional case and sampled model outputs differ. The score is a new ruler baseline, not a treatment effect.
